items.proposed: Agreed coding stands: no candidate; candidate_exclusion_reason excluded_intervention_type
items.reason: The investigational question is the device ('Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) in Combination With Chemotherapy'); the 'second-line chemotherapy' / 'BPC chemotherapy' is unnamed, not a registered drug intervention, and given to every patient as 'Second line conventional treatment', i.e. background. No named drug can be a candidate.

note: Registry phase is NA, so the trial is excluded at S3 (phase_not_applicable) before S6; the S6 reason is moot. S6 reason changed from the coders' agreed no_pharmacological_candidate to excluded_intervention_type under D31-C1, because the tested intervention is the TTFields device. Nothing pending for XL.

revisions.reason: The record tests a device ('Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) in Combination With Chemotherapy', registered as combination product TTFields), so D31-C1 assigns excluded_intervention_type.
